name: The Fresh Factory
summary: The Fresh Factory B.C. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company focused on accelerating the growth of fresh, clean-label, plant-based food and beverage brands. It develops, manufactures, and sells products made from fresh produce and ingredients. Its products include cold-pressed juice, dips and spreads, dressings and sauces, and snack bars. The company was founded by Bill Besenhofer and Nate Laurell on October 2, 2018 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
